verses.original: אַבְרָ֔ם אֵ֣שֶׁת וְשָׂרַי֙ יָלְדָ֖ה ל֑וֹ לֹ֥א וְלָ֛הּ מִצְרִ֖ית שִׁפְחָ֥ה וּשְׁמָ֥הּ הָגָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḇ·rām ’ê·šeṯ wə·śā·ray yā·lə·ḏāh lōw lō wə·lāh miṣ·rîṯ šip̄·ḥāh ū·šə·māh hā·ḡār
verses.literal: Now Abram’s wife Sarai had borne him no [children] but she had an Egyptian maidservant named Hagar

verses.original: שָׂרַ֜י וַתֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ אַבְרָ֗ם הִנֵּה־ נָ֞א יְהוָה֙ עֲצָרַ֤נִי מִלֶּ֔דֶת נָא֙ בֹּא־ אֶל־ שִׁפְחָתִ֔י אוּלַ֥י אִבָּנֶ֖ה מִמֶּ֑נָּה אַבְרָ֖ם וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע לְק֥וֹל שָׂרָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: śā·ray wat·tō·mer ’el- ’aḇ·rām hin·nêh- nā Yah·weh ‘ă·ṣā·ra·nî mil·le·ḏeṯ nā bō- ’el- šip̄·ḥā·ṯî ’ū·lay ’ib·bā·neh mim·mɛn·nå̄h ’aḇ·rām way·yiš·ma‘ lə·qō·wl śā·rāy
verses.literal: So Sarai said to Abram Look now the LORD has prevented me from bearing [children] Please go to my maidservant perhaps I can build a family by her And Abram listened to the voice of Sarai

verses.original: מִקֵּץ֙ אַבְרָ֖ם לְשֶׁ֥בֶת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן עֶ֣שֶׂר שָׁנִ֔ים אַבְרָ֗ם אֶת־ אֵֽשֶׁת־ שָׂרַ֣י וַתִּקַּ֞ח הַמִּצְרִית֙ שִׁפְחָתָ֔הּ הָגָ֤ר וַתִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛הּ לְאַבְרָ֥ם אִישָׁ֖הּ ל֥וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: miq·qêṣ ’aḇ·rām lə·še·ḇeṯ bə·’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an ‘e·śer šā·nîm ’aḇ·rām ’eṯ- ’ê·šeṯ- śā·ray wat·tiq·qaḥ ham·miṣ·rîṯ šip̄·ḥā·ṯāh hā·ḡār wat·tit·tên ’ō·ṯāh lə·’aḇ·rām ’î·šāh lōw lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: So after [he] had lived vvv in Canaan for ten years [his] - wife Sarai took her Egyptian maidservant Hagar and gave her to Abram - to be his wife

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א אֶל־ הָגָ֖ר וַתַּ֑הַר וַתֵּ֙רֶא֙ כִּ֣י הָרָ֔תָה וַתֵּקַ֥ל בְּעֵינֶֽיהָ׃ גְּבִרְתָּ֖הּ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’el- hā·ḡār wat·ta·har wat·tê·re kî hā·rā·ṯāh wat·tê·qal bə·‘ê·ne·hā gə·ḇir·tāh
verses.literal: And he slept with . . . Hagar and she conceived But when [Hagar] realized that she was pregnant she began to despise . . . her mistress

verses.original: שָׂרַ֣י וַתֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ אַבְרָם֮ חֲמָסִ֣י עָלֶיךָ֒ אָנֹכִ֗י נָתַ֤תִּי שִׁפְחָתִי֙ בְּחֵיקֶ֔ךָ וַתֵּ֙רֶא֙ כִּ֣י הָרָ֔תָה וָאֵקַ֖ל בְּעֵינֶ֑יהָ יְהוָ֖ה יִשְׁפֹּ֥ט בֵּינִ֥י וּבֵינֶֽיׄךָ׃
verses.transliteration: śā·ray wat·tō·mer ’el- ’aḇ·rām ḥă·mā·sî ‘ā·le·ḵā ’ā·nō·ḵî nā·ṯat·tî šip̄·ḥā·ṯî bə·ḥê·qe·ḵā wat·tê·re kî hā·rā·ṯāh wā·’ê·qal bə·‘ê·ne·hā Yah·weh yiš·pōṭ bê·nî ū·ḇē·nɛ·ḵå̄
verses.literal: Then Sarai said to Abram May the wrong done to me [be] upon you I delivered my servant into your arms and ever since she saw that she was pregnant she has treated me with contempt . . . May the LORD judge between you and me . . .

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אַבְרָ֜ם אֶל־ שָׂרַ֗י שִׁפְחָתֵךְ֙ בְּיָדֵ֔ךְ עֲשִׂי־ הַטּ֣וֹב בְּעֵינָ֑יִךְ לָ֖הּ שָׂרַ֔י וַתְּעַנֶּ֣הָ וַתִּבְרַ֖ח מִפָּנֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh way·yō·mer ’aḇ·rām ’el- śā·ray šip̄·ḥā·ṯêḵ bə·yā·ḏêḵ ‘ă·śî- haṭ·ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·nā·yiḵ lāh śā·ray wat·tə·‘an·ne·hā wat·tiḇ·raḥ mip·pā·ne·hā
verses.literal: Here said Abram - - your servant is in your hands Do whatever you want with her Then Sarai treated [Hagar] so harshly that she fled from her

verses.original: מַלְאַ֧ךְ יְהוָ֛ה וַֽיִּמְצָאָ֞הּ עַל־ עֵ֥ין הַמַּ֖יִם בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר עַל־ הָעַ֖יִן בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ שֽׁוּר׃
verses.transliteration: mal·’aḵ Yah·weh way·yim·ṣā·’āh ‘al- ‘ên ham·ma·yim bam·miḏ·bār ‘al- hā·‘a·yin bə·ḏe·reḵ šūr
verses.literal: Now the angel of the LORD found [Hagar] by a spring of water in the desert . . . the spring along the road to Shur

verses.original: הָגָ֞ר שִׁפְחַ֥ת שָׂרַ֛י וַיֹּאמַ֗ר אֵֽי־ מִזֶּ֥ה בָ֖את וְאָ֣נָה תֵלֵ֑כִי אָנֹכִ֖י בֹּרַֽחַת׃ מִפְּנֵי֙ גְּבִרְתִּ֔י שָׂרַ֣י וַתֹּ֕אמֶר
verses.transliteration: hā·ḡār šip̄·ḥaṯ śā·ray way·yō·mar ’ê- miz·zeh ḇāṯ wə·’ā·nāh ṯê·lê·ḵî ’ā·nō·ḵî bō·ra·ḥaṯ mip·pə·nê gə·ḇir·tî śā·ray wat·tō·mer
verses.literal: Hagar servant of Sarai he said where . . . have you come from and where are you going I am running away from my mistress Sarai she replied

verses.original: מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהּ֙ שׁ֖וּבִי אֶל־ גְּבִרְתֵּ֑ךְ וְהִתְעַנִּ֖י תַּ֥חַת יָדֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: mal·’aḵ Yah·weh way·yō·mer lāh šū·ḇî ’el- gə·ḇir·têḵ wə·hiṯ·‘an·nî ta·ḥaṯ yā·ḏe·hā
verses.literal: So the angel of the LORD told her Return to your mistress and submit to her authority . . .

verses.original: מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהּ֙ הַרְבָּ֥ה אַרְבֶּ֖ה אֶת־ זַרְעֵ֑ךְ וְלֹ֥א מֵרֹֽב׃ יִסָּפֵ֖ר
verses.transliteration: mal·’aḵ Yah·weh way·yō·mer lāh har·bāh ’ar·beh ’eṯ- zar·‘êḵ wə·lō mê·rōḇ yis·sā·p̄êr
verses.literal: Then the angel . . . added I will greatly multiply . . . - your offspring so that they will be too numerous to count

verses.original: מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהּ֙ הִנָּ֥ךְ הָרָ֖ה וְיֹלַ֣דְתְּ בֵּ֑ן וְקָרָ֤את שְׁמוֹ֙ יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ שָׁמַ֥ע עָנְיֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: mal·’aḵ Yah·weh way·yō·mer lāh hin·nāḵ hā·rāh wə·yō·laḏt bên wə·qā·rāṯ šə·mōw yiš·mā·‘êl kî- Yah·weh ’el- šā·ma‘ ‘ā·nə·yêḵ
verses.literal: The angel of the LORD proceeded . . . Behold you have conceived and will bear a son And you shall name him . . . Ishmael for the LORD . . . has heard your cry of affliction

verses.original: וְה֤וּא יִהְיֶה֙ פֶּ֣רֶא אָדָ֔ם יָד֣וֹ בַכֹּ֔ל כֹּ֖ל וְיַ֥ד בּ֑וֹ יִשְׁכֹּֽן׃ וְעַל־ פְּנֵ֥י כָל־ אֶחָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: wə·hū yih·yeh pe·re ’ā·ḏām yā·ḏōw ḇak·kōl kōl wə·yaḏ bōw yiš·kōn wə·‘al- pə·nê ḵāl ’e·ḥāw
verses.literal: He will be a wild donkey [of a] man and his hand will be against everyone and everyone’s hand against him he will live in hostility toward all his brothers

verses.original: וַתִּקְרָ֤א שֵׁם־ יְהוָה֙ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר אֵלֶ֔יהָ אַתָּ֖ה אֵ֣ל רֳאִ֑י כִּ֣י אָֽמְרָ֗ה הֲלֹ֛ם הֲגַ֥ם רָאִ֖יתִי אַחֲרֵ֥י רֹאִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·rā šêm- Yah·weh had·dō·ḇêr ’ê·le·hā ’at·tāh ’êl ro·’î kî ’ā·mə·rāh hă·lōm hă·ḡam rā·’î·ṯî ’a·ḥă·rê rō·’î
verses.literal: So [Hagar] gave this name to the LORD who had spoken to her You are the God who sees me for she said Here I have seen . . . the One who sees me

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּן֙ לַבְּאֵ֔ר קָרָ֣א בְּאֵ֥ר לַחַ֖י רֹאִ֑י הִנֵּ֥ה בֵין־ קָדֵ֖שׁ וּבֵ֥ין בָּֽרֶד׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên lab·bə·’êr qā·rā bə·’êr la·ḥay rō·’î hin·nêh ḇên- qā·ḏêš ū·ḇên bā·reḏ
verses.literal: Therefore . . . the well was called vvv vvv Beer-lahai-roi It is located between Kadesh . . . and Bered

verses.original: הָגָ֛ר וַתֵּ֧לֶד לְאַבְרָ֖ם בֵּ֑ן אַבְרָ֧ם וַיִּקְרָ֨א שֶׁם־ יִשְׁמָעֵֽאל׃ בְּנ֛וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ הָגָ֖ר יָלְדָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: hā·ḡār wat·tê·leḏ lə·’aḇ·rām bên ’aḇ·rām way·yiq·rā šem- yiš·mā·‘êl bə·nōw ’ă·šer- hā·ḡār yā·lə·ḏāh
verses.literal: And Hagar bore Abram a son and Abram gave the name Ishmael to the son - [she] had borne

verses.original: וְאַבְרָ֕ם שְׁמֹנִ֥ים וְשֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֑ים בֶּן־ שָׁנָ֖ה הָגָ֥ר אֶת־ בְּלֶֽדֶת־ יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל לְאַבְרָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’aḇ·rām šə·mō·nîm wə·šêš šā·nîm ben- šā·nāh hā·ḡār ’eṯ- bə·le·ḏeṯ- yiš·mā·‘êl lə·’aḇ·rām
verses.literal: Abram was eighty-six . . . years old . . . when Hagar - bore Ishmael to him
